fact: maCERT, the DGSSI's cyber watch and response centre, issued a security warning bulletin (ref. 65471806/26) on the FortiBleed leak affecting Fortinet firewalls and SSL VPN gateways, saying several Moroccan institutions were affected and urging MFA and password changes.
maCERT is described as the DGSSI's centre for vigilance, monitoring and response to cyber attacks, operating under the National Defence Administration.
The strategy states Morocco adopted its first national cybersecurity strategy in 2012.

The DGSSI publishes the Stratégie Nationale de Cybersécurité 2030 as the successor to the 2012 strategy, with 4 pillars, 11 objectives, 26 initiatives and 60 actions; the document is undated and its date here is the 2024 published proxy.
The strategy's legal timeline states Décret n° 2-11-509 created the DGSSI in 2011.
The DGSSI is stated to have updated the national information security directive (DNSSI v2.0, Circulaire 2/2023) drawing on its own control, audit and incident-handling actions across organisations.

Morocco's DGSSI, under the National Defense Administration, is stated to host Morocco CyberSecurity Week and to have deployed security operations centres and strengthened oversight and auditing in recent years.
The decision states the DGSSI was created by Décret n° 2-11-509 of 21 September 2011, and names it for EU capacity-building support.

DGSSI (Direction Generale de la Securite des Systemes d'Information), under the National Defence Administration, is stated to exist and operate, opening a competition for 10 State engineers in information systems security for it, applications due before 10 April 2026; the page carries no date and the published date (2026-03) is derived.

The Ministry of Digital Transition's communique of 25 July 2026 says Morocco, in its statement at the African Telecommunications Union conference, highlighted progress under its national cybersecurity strategy to 2030 (period given only as horizon 2030; no adoption date stated).

fact: The DGSSI, under the Administration de la Defense nationale, runs a Centre de veille, de detection et de reponse aux attaques informatiques.
The DGSSI said 109 of 879 recorded cyberattacks in 2025 needed direct intervention by its Centre de veille, and it issued 22 security alerts and 511 bulletins.
Minister Delegate Abdellatif Loudiyi gave 879 attacks recorded, 109 direct interventions, 22 alerts and 511 bulletins (248 critical) for 2025.
Morocco's Minister Delegate for National Defense told Parliament that of 644 cyberattacks recorded by DGSSI in 2024, 134 required a response by maCERT.
The minister told Parliament DGSSI recorded 644 attacks, issued 1,050 notifications and 575 security bulletins and 16 vulnerability alerts in 2024 to date.
